meta.projection_method: Ending balance = deposit x (1 + APY)^years, using each bank's verified APY as the effective annual rate (the definition of APY already reflects compounding). Assumes a single deposit on 2026-10-22, no withdrawals or added deposits, the variable APY held constant for illustration only, and no monthly fees deducted (see each account's fee/waiver terms). Accounts whose APY could not be verified on an official page are excluded from projections and shown blank.
meta.ranking_source: Federal Reserve, Large Commercial Banks ranking (domestic assets), as of June 30, 2026: https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/lbr/current/default.htm
